text: Core courses University Mathematics, Measuring and Cartography, Natural Geography, Economic Geography, Basic Architecture, Principle of Environmentology, Architectural Drawing Reading and Graphics, Human Geography, Urban Geography, Western Economics, Management, Urban Planning, Geographical Information System, Urban Land Management, Real Estate Economics, Regional Analysis and Planning, Construction Projects--Quota and Budget, Investment Analysis of Real Estate, Law of Real Estate, Real Estate Finance, Real Estate Development and Management, Real Estate Price Assessment, Estate Management, Real Estate Marketing and Garden Planning and Design. Objective This objective is to train students to be high-quality professional personnel to work, after graduation, in scientific research institutions, colleges and universities or enterprises and administrative service departments; their occupation is related to research, teaching or administration affairs. The objective is also to train students to be able to work in real estate companies, financial institutions, colleges and universities, or land-affairs administration offices to be engaged in a variety of careers such as real estate investment, development, estate management, land business and administration. Schooling Length In standards it lasts four years. The minimum of schooling length must be three years and its extension lasts no more than seven years. Credits The minimum of 170 credits must be obtained for graduation. Diploma Bachelor of Science is granted.
